subject: Initial discovery: aligning AE/SE with Tesseract engineering lead
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@tesseract.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 16:12:00 -0500
Subject: Intro + discovery — propose 45m slots (AE + SE + Eng lead)

Hannah — thanks again for the quick intro on Friday. Would love to get a 30–45m discovery call on the calendar so we can: 1) understand your primary latency/cost pain points, 2) confirm security/procurement constraints, and 3) surface an initial pilot scope and mutual action plan.

Proposed 45m windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 2 — 9:00–9:45am or 2:00–2:45pm
- Wed Nov 3 — 10:30–11:15am or 3:00–3:45pm

Agenda (draft) attached: discovery focused — goals, current infra, sample workload, security/compliance checklist. Please add anyone from engineering or procurement who should attend (engineering lead + a procurement contact would be great).

If none of those work, send a couple of alternatives and we’ll accommodate. I’ve CC’d Soojin (our SE) and Karthik (AM) so they can join.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Attachment: tesseract_discovery_agenda.pdf
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@tesseract.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery — propose 45m slots (AE + SE + Eng lead)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the options. Quick note on attendees: I’m adding our Engineering Lead, Carlos Mendoza (cc’d), and looping in procurement (procurement@tesseract.ai) as they need to be aware for budget/PO tracking.

Our availability (PST):
- Tue Nov 2 — 2:00–2:30pm (Carlos has a conflict at 2:30)
- Wed Nov 3 — blocked for leadership offsite all day
- Thu Nov 4 — 10:00–10:45am or 1:00–1:45pm

If possible, can we keep the call tight (30m) and focus on: current inference throughput, data residency questions, and procurement timeline? Carlos — feel free to add anything. Also, we’ll want a short pre-demo checklist sent to procurement in case they need documentation.

Best,
Hannah Li
Product Champion, Tesseract AI
H: +1 (206) 555-4432
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@tesseract.ai>, Carlos Mendoza <carlos.m@tesseract.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 08:25:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery — propose 45m slots (AE + SE + Eng lead)

Thanks Hannah — great context. I can do Thu Nov 4 at 10:00am PST for a 30m discovery. Agenda we’ll follow (30m):
- 0–5m: intros & desired outcomes (Hannah)
- 5–12m: current infra + latency/cost targets (Carlos)
- 12–22m: how Redwood would approach a pilot (SE walkthrough)
- 22–30m: next steps / procurement items needed

I attached our short pre-demo checklist for procurement to make the scheduling and security questions easier (certificate types, SOC2 evidence, data retention policy). If procurement will review before the call, it may expedite follow-ups.

Also: quick timezone note — I’m in EST. Calendar invite will be sent for 10:00am PST / 1:00pm EST.

If the 10:00am slot works, we’ll include an optional security observer (if you want Anika or someone from your security team to join).

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_pre-demo-checklist.docx
From: Carlos Mendoza <carlos.m@tesseract.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Li <hannah.li@tesseract.ai>, procurement@tesseract.ai
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery — propose 45m slots (AE + SE + Eng lead)

Thanks — appreciate the clarity. Unfortunately leadership offsite ran over and I won’t be able to make Thu at 10. Two quick asks / proposals:
1) Can we move to Mon Nov 8 at 10:00am PST (30m)? That works best for engineering.
2) Please include our security contact Anika Roy (anika.roy@tesseract.ai) on the invite — she’ll likely listen in for SOC2/data handling questions.

Procurement — we’ve started an internal PO request; if Redwood can share the checklist and a brief note on the pilot billing model (monthly committed vs usage-based) that would help speed approvals.

Thanks,
Carlos Mendoza
Engineering Lead, Tesseract AI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@tesseract.ai>, Carlos Mendoza <carlos.m@tesseract.ai>, Anika Roy <anika.roy@tesseract.ai>, procurement@tesseract.ai
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 04 Nov 2027 14:05:00 -0500
Subject: Confirmed: Discovery call (Mon Nov 8, 10:00am PST) + agenda/docs

Thanks all — confirmed for Mon Nov 8, 10:00–10:30am PST (calendar invite sent: https://redwood.app/s/meetings/INVITE-abc123).

Quick notes and attachments included:
- Final agenda (short) and objectives — we’ll keep it to 30m and action-driven.
- Pre-demo checklist (attached) for procurement/security — if procurement can share any required CISO contacts or an internal vendor form ahead of the call, that will speed follow-up.
- Billing note: we’ll cover both committed pilot and usage-based options at a high level; no hard numbers on this call.

If anyone needs a different time, please flag ASAP — otherwise we’ll proceed and Soojin will run the SE portion live.

Looking forward to it,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: tesseract_discovery_agenda.pdf, redwood_pre-demo-checklist.docx
